purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Fresno County Assessor and GIS sources document parcel mapping and a public county parcel FeatureServer. Its layer schema exposes APN and geometry without owner/address fields; the exact WUP locator intersects one full polygon. This establishes county GIS coverage at the locator, not citywide completeness or legal-survey accuracy.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Fresno County Assessor mapping page describes APNs as real-property identifiers and links GIS parcel resources.
Official Fresno County GIS portal catalogs public hosted parcel GIS data.
Public ArcGIS layer metadata returned HTTP 200 and identifies a polygon layer with safe APN and geometry fields; owner/address data were not requested.
Exact WUP-point query returned HTTP 200 with one full polygon and APN 43614106. Geometry is retained separately without service attributes.
